handbookNote: Batch-2 depth expansion for New Jersey Law on Notarial Acts, P.L.1979, c.460 (N.J.S.A. 52:7-10 et seq.), as amended and supplemented by P.L.2021, c.179 -- commissioned by the State Treasurer via the Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (not the Secretary of State). Adds scenario/application questions, procedural deep-dives (course of study, examination administration, interim rulemaking), previously untested statutory subsections (definitions, discipline grounds, nonresident certificate filing, journal entry contents, federal/tribal recognition), and integrated cross-reference/error-pattern questions, deliberately avoiding restated duplicates of the batch-1 question set in temp/questions/nj_notary/. Price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder.
